SELECT
    C.CUSTOMER_ID AS MEMBER_ID,

    TRIM(C.CUSTOMER_NM)
        AS MEMBER_NAME,

    REGEXP_REPLACE(
        C.PHONE_NO,
        '[^0-9]',
        ''
    ) AS MOBILE_NO,

    CASE
        WHEN C.STATUS_CD = 'A'
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END AS USE_YN,

    G.GRADE_NM AS MEMBER_GRADE,

    CAST(
        C.REG_DT AS TIMESTAMP
    ) AS CREATED_AT,

    CAST(
        NVL(C.MOD_DT, C.REG_DT)
        AS TIMESTAMP
    ) AS UPDATED_AT

FROM SRC_CUSTOMER C

LEFT JOIN SRC_CUSTOMER_GRADE G
       ON G.GRADE_CD = C.GRADE_CD

WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID > :LAST_ID

    END, 'Y') AS USE_YN,

FROM LEGACY_APP.SRC_CUSTOMER

sqlgen.sourceSelectSql:
-- 원본 읽기: Fetch 5,000행씩 스트리밍
-- 원본 SQL을 인라인 뷰 S로 감싸 변환식·NULL 처리·체크포인트를 붙임
-- :LAST_ID = 체크포인트(SQL 안 조건, 없으면 입력한 값)
-- 작업자 4개: MEMBER_ID 범위를 나눠 :RANGE_TO까지씩 읽음
SELECT
    MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID,
    MEMBER_NAME AS MEMBER_NAME,
    MOBILE_NO AS MOBILE_NO,
    NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') AS USE_YN,
    MEMBER_GRADE AS MEMBER_GRADE,
    CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT,
    UPDATED_AT AS UPDATED_AT
FROM (
    SELECT
        C.CUSTOMER_ID AS MEMBER_ID,
    
        TRIM(C.CUSTOMER_NM)
            AS MEMBER_NAME,
    
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            C.PHONE_NO,
            '[^0-9]',
            ''
        ) AS MOBILE_NO,
    
        CASE
            WHEN C.STATUS_CD = 'A'
            THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
        END AS USE_YN,
    
        G.GRADE_NM AS MEMBER_GRADE,
    
        CAST(
            C.REG_DT AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS CREATED_AT,
    
        CAST(
            NVL(C.MOD_DT, C.REG_DT)
            AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS UPDATED_AT
    
    FROM SRC_CUSTOMER C
    
    LEFT JOIN SRC_CUSTOMER_GRADE G
           ON G.GRADE_CD = C.GRADE_CD
    
    WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID > :LAST_ID
) S
WHERE S.MEMBER_ID <= :RANGE_TO
ORDER BY S.MEMBER_ID

MERGE INTO NEXT_APP.TB_MEMBER T
USING (
    SELECT
        :MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID,
        :MEMBER_NAME AS MEMBER_NAME,
        :MOBILE_NO AS MOBILE_NO,
        :USE_YN AS USE_YN,
        :CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT,
        :UPDATED_AT AS UPDATED_AT
    FROM DUAL
) S
ON (
    T.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID
)
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        T.MEMBER_NAME = S.MEMBER_NAME,
        T.MOBILE_NO = S.MOBILE_NO,
        T.USE_YN = S.USE_YN,
        T.CREATED_AT = S.CREATED_AT,
        T.UPDATED_AT = S.UPDATED_AT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (
        MEMBER_ID,
        MEMBER_NAME,
        MOBILE_NO,
        USE_YN,
        CREATED_AT,
        UPDATED_AT
    )
    VALUES (
        S.MEMBER_ID,
        S.MEMBER_NAME,
        S.MOBILE_NO,
        S.USE_YN,
        S.CREATED_AT,
        S.UPDATED_AT
    )
LOG ERRORS INTO NEXT_APP.ERR$_TB_MEMBER ('RUN_ID') REJECT LIMIT UNLIMITED

  port: '1521'
